brand_palette.approach: Deep slate-blue / teal palette (accent-deep #2f4f5c, accent-mid #5c8699, accent-soft #dbe6e7), light base (bg #f4f6f5), warm charcoal ink (#202b2c). Deliberately avoids gold/champagne (used heavily by belezalash, mixnminxlashes, etherealeyelashesfl - all lash businesses already processed) and pink/plum (used by lashesdeve, lashbloom). Also distinct from the parallel build 'Lash Mastery & Aesthetics Co' (lashmasteryco), which uses a dark charcoal + gold/bronze palette. The slate-blue direction also loosely echoes the studio's real interior (soft powder-blue accent wall visible in bk-3) without copying any competitor's exact hues.
